column1: # The provenance manifest — every bundle, and the artifact it claims to bind.
# bundle <TAB> target (absolute path AS THE EXECUTOR SAW IT) <TAB> git rev:path <TAB> source (optional)
# ⚠️ `--against HEAD:...` is deliberate, not a pin. A pinned rev would go on
# passing forever while the live artifact drifted away from its birth record;
# HEAD is what makes drift a RED. The birth commit is recorded in the comment
# beside each row, which is where a pin belongs.
# S2 — the bitonic sort. Program landed bf2de34; bundle landed a5d2ef7 (next commit).
